name: Waigeo Brushturkey
rangeDescription: Waigeo (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A very little-known, large, black ground bird endemic to the upland forests on Waigeo Island. Black above with some chestnut in the breast and a bare pink head and throat.

name: Eastern Double-collared Sunbird
rangeDescription: Highlands of kenya and northern tanzania
description: A medium-sized sunbird. Males are colorful, red and green, and females drab brownish.

name: Choco Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid forest of northwestern colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: Small, rare woodpecker restricted to very wet lowland and foothill rainforest in western Colombia and far northwestern Ecuador. Both sexes have olive back and wings, extensive dark barring on underparts, and golden nape.

name: White-chested Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru, the guianas, and western amazonian brazil
description: Brown-and-white streaked bird with a large head and yellowish bill; white crescent on chest is helpful for identification but can be difficult to see. Inhabits lower and middle levels of tall rainforest, where it is easily overlooked as it sits motionless for long periods before darting to tree trunks, foliage, or ground for large insect and small vertebrate prey.

name: Tytler's Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Coniferous forest of pakistan and northern india; winters to myanmar
description: Slender leaf warbler with no wingbar, greenish wings contrasting with grayish upperparts, a long, contrasting white eyebrow, and a long, pointed, mostly dark bill. Endemic to the Indian Subcontinent.

name: Pallid Harrier
rangeDescription: Central eurasia; winters to southern africa, india, and myanmar
description: Males are ghostly gray above with black wingtip wedges. Females are more difficult to separate from other harriers; pay attention to the underwings with their barred primaries and dark secondaries.

name: Golden Greenbul
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to gabon, angola, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo; bioko
description: A golden-green bird of forest and forest edge, often seen high above the ground in fruiting trees with other species. Mostly uniform golden-yellow below and yellow-green above with a distinctive pale pinkish bill that is often darkest towards the tip.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Golden Palm Weaver
rangeDescription: Savanna of ethiopia to southern somalia, eastern kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: Breeding male is bright yellow with a mostly orange head. The female is duller, though still very yellow.

name: Subantarctic Shearwater
rangeDescription: Tristan da cunha, gough, chatham, and antipodes islands
description: A small shearwater, with black coloring above and white below. The black on the face passes below the eye.

name: Banded Cotinga
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia and minas gerais to rio de janeiro)
description: Jaw-droppingly beautiful bird. Males are cobalt-blue and purple, while females are dusky brown above with white scaling and buff below with dark spots.

name: Slaty-backed Hemispingus
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (mérida and northern táchira)
description: A beautiful small tanager with attractive contrasting colors: slate gray upperparts, orange underparts, black mask, and a bright white eyebrow. Sexes similar, but male is richer orange.

name: White-lined Antbird
rangeDescription: Far southwestern amazonian brazil to southeastern peru and northwestern bolivia
description: Large antbird of bamboo stands in river edge forest. Males are dark gray with bright white wing bars and a darker blackish crest that is raised when agitated; females appear two-toned: orange above, with creamy white face and underparts.

name: Taiwan Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, strikingly patterned songbird endemic to Taiwan, where fairly common. Brown above, white below, with white supercilium, black mask, and heavy black spots on the breast.

name: Rufous Cisticola
rangeDescription: Grassland of gambia to lake chad and central african republic
description: A small, brownish upland cisticola. Remarkably plain: brown on the upperparts and buff below.

name: Common Shelduck
rangeDescription: Breeds western europe to east-central asia; winters to northern africa through southern asia
description: Distinctive, large, rather gooselike duck of coastal wetlands, tidal mudflats, and nearby grassy fields. Striking plumage often looks simply black-and-white; at close range, head is deep glossy green, broad breast band dark rusty.

name: Colombian Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Northern and central colombia
description: Large chickenlike bird. Restricted to central Colombia; the only chachalaca in its limited range.

name: Pin-tailed Snipe
rangeDescription: Siberia; winters india to southeastern asia, indonesia, and philippines
description: Cryptic shorebird of wetlands, wet meadows, and both flooded and dry agricultural fields. Extremely similar in appearance to other snipe, particularly Swinhoe's Snipe; careful study and photography usually required to confirm identification.

name: Cordillera Ground-Warbler
rangeDescription: Northern luzon (northernmost ilocos norte province), philippines
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland forest floor in northern Luzon. Fairly stout, with a pale lower bill, long legs, and large feet.

name: Baird's Trogon
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and western panama
description: Unique trogon with dark purplish head and breast, turquoise back, white undertail, and pale blue bill and eyering. No white band between chest and belly.

name: Makira Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Makira (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A tiny warbler with a mostly gray head, a dark eye-stripe, and a pale eyebrow. Back and wings strongly green-toned with two buff wingbars.
